name: logbrew/sdk
description: Public LogBrew PHP SDK for building, validating, and flushing event batches.

suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: Required for Guzzle 7 outbound HTTP tracing.
suggest.laravel/framework: Required for Laravel queue job tracing.
suggest.monolog/monolog: Required for Monolog and Laravel logging channels.
suggest.symfony/console: Required for the optional Symfony status and delivery-probe command.
suggest.psr/http-client: Required to wrap an app-owned PSR-18 client.
suggest.psr/http-message: Required for outbound HTTP request and response interfaces.
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: Required for the native Symfony bundle and request telemetry.
suggest.symfony/monolog-bundle: Required for automatic Symfony Monolog capture.
